song_craft: Voice: śānta couplets, mirror-light register (still, clear, unforced). Arc: light unobjectifiable (v1) → non-duality (v2) → positive declaration with division inside (v3) → difference uncut + bare list (v4) → mirror a-fortiori (v5) → address: You alone (v6) → paradox praised (v7) → seal: hymn names its close (v8). Sthāyin śānta throughout; adbhuta/ānanda color single verses. L4 = L3 verbatim, music named.

lines: That split — and this one — is not cut off from it: from the free, the flawlessly clear, the single abode.
Palace, elephant, horse, cloud, ocean, mountain, and the rest — just as with jewel, mirror, and the like.

verses.craft: Bare list kept whole (exhaustive-or-exemplary open); jewel-mirror kept; uncut-from-ground hinge.
verses.rejected: (a) trimming list → killed: bare list is the proof. (b) flawlessly→perfectly → killed: L3 frozen.
